summary.name: Tomato 2
summary.one_liner: Tomato 2 is a Mac app for the Pomodoro Technique with flexible session timing, weekly session stats, and website blocking during work sessions.
use_cases: run focused work sessions with the Pomodoro Technique
schedule breaks synced to the clock
review what you worked on across the week
block distracting websites during work sessions
summary.what_it_does: Tomato 2 is a Mac app implementing the Pomodoro Technique. It offers timing modes, including exact 25-minute sessions or open-ended sessions that continue while work is going well. Sessions can be synced to the clock, for example taking breaks at the 25th and 55th minute of each hour. Users can set session goals and view them in a weekly stats view. It can also block websites of the user's choice during a session.
notable: Available on the Mac App Store (listed as freeware in awesome-mac)
caveats: Platform support appears limited to Mac; no other platforms named on the page
Pricing not stated on the page itself; the awesome-mac listing marks it as freeware
